plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: A planning layer that thinks freely, a Kanban, and an isolated executor. /dig (discuss), /demo (clickable fake-data UI to react to), /carve (planner: feature + issues on one branch, optional independent challenge), /crank (control plane: claim, worktree, scope gate, verify, merge, integrate, close). Anything may advise; only execution isolation and failed verification may block.
